units.source_text: 仪式完成之后，源氏召集诸儒学博士及学者，令他们赋诗。

en.t: After the ceremony was completed, Genji summoned the Confucian doctors and scholars and had them compose poems.

units.source_text: 其他通晓此道的公卿与殿上人，也都被留住，参与其事。

en.t: Other nobles and courtiers who were versed in this art were also kept there and took part in the occasion.

units.source_text: 博士们作律诗；源氏内大臣以下其他诸人，都作绝句。

en.t: The doctors composed regulated verse, while Genji, the Minister of the Interior, and the others below him all composed quatrains.

units.source_text: 由儒学博士选择富有趣味的题目。

en.t: The Confucian doctors selected topics full of interest and charm.

units.source_text: 夏夜苦短，赋诗完毕时天色已明，便开始讲解诗篇。

en.t: The summer night was painfully short, and by the time the poems were finished, dawn had already broken, so the explanations of the poems began.
The Left Middle Controller was appointed as the lecturer.

units.source_text: 此人相貌清秀，声音洪亮，庄严堂皇地朗诵诗篇，那态度极有风趣。

en.t: This man had refined good looks and a resonant voice, and as he recited the poems with solemn grandeur, his manner was remarkably elegant and engaging.

units.source_text: 他是个声望甚高而修养甚深的儒学博士。

en.t: He was a Confucian doctor of very high reputation and deep cultivation.
